description: Workflow step-file frontmatter is being used as a per-run outputs log (status, started-at, completed-at, plus an outputs map with run data like new-recordings-count and api-total), duplicating state.yaml accumulated-context and bloating step files with run-specific data. Controller flagged that this burns tokens unnecessarily on every step read/write.
correction: Step frontmatter must record ONLY current-step execution state (status, started-at, completed-at). Run outputs belong in state.yaml accumulated-context alone. No step file becomes a log of step history.
systemic_fix: Rigby to update reference/workflow-conventions.md Step Frontmatter Convention (drop outputs map from schema), sweep workflows/*/steps/*.md frontmatter to the minimal schema, and verify step-complete/guardrail hooks do not depend on outputs frontmatter. Convention change routed to Rigby 2026-10-13.
fix_applied: 2026-10-13: Rigby applied the convention change. reference/workflow-conventions.md schema reduced to status/started-at/completed-at; all 295 workflows/*/steps/*.md frontmatter stripped of outputs maps and run-log keys; YOUR TASK instructions re-pointed to state.yaml accumulated-context; .claude/hooks/step-complete.py fallback reads state.yaml via new load_step_outputs(); new shared loader systems/eval-harness/step_outputs.py; 28 verify scripts re-pointed to state.yaml; boot step-02 guardrail retry text updated.
